requirements.title: Temperature Reading and Control Range
requirements.description: Allow a user to monitor and read temperature at a thermostat, and set thermostat target temperatures between 60°F and 80°F inclusive at 1°F increments.

source_references.section: 4.2.1.1 A DH user shall be able to read the tempera ture at a thermostat
source_references.excerpt: A DH user shall be able to set the thermost at temperatures to between 60 ° F and 80 ° F, inclusive, at one degree increments.

requirements.title: Humidistat Reading and Control Range
requirements.description: Allow a user to monitor humidity at a humidistat position and set the relative humidity level from 30% to 60% inclusive in 1% increments.

source_references.section: 4.2.1.1 A DH user shall be able to read the tempera ture at a thermostat
source_references.excerpt: A DH user shall be able to set the humidity level for a humidistat, from 30% to 60%, inclusive a 1% increments.

requirements.title: Security Alarm Activation on Breach
requirements.description: Manage up to 50 door and window contact sensors and automatically activate both light and sound alarms when a security breach occurs and a contact sensor is set OPEN.

source_references.section: 4.3.2.3 For each humidistat, up to twenty-four one hour settings per day
source_references.excerpt: When a security breach occurs and a contact s ensor is set OPEN, the alarm system shall be activated.

requirements.title: Appliance Power Switch Control
requirements.description: Manage power switches connected to small appliances and allow users to query switch state (OFF or ON) and toggle switch states.

source_references.section: 4.3.2.3 For each humidistat, up to twenty-four one hour settings per day
source_references.excerpt: The system shall be able to change the state of a power switch (OFF to ON, or ON to OFF)

requirements.title: Monthly Environment Planning and Manual Override
requirements.description: Provide a monthly planner where users can set environmental parameters for up to four daily time periods, while allowing manual or website overrides until the end of the planned period.

source_references.section: 4.6.2.2 A user shall be able to override planned pa rameter values,
source_references.excerpt: A user shall be able to override planned pa rameter values, through the DH website, or if available, through manual switches on household devices

requirements.title: Historical Environmental Monthly Reporting
requirements.description: Generate monthly reports for any month in the past two years containing temperature/humidity averages and extremes, security breach timestamps, and system downtime periods.

source_references.section: 4.6.2.2 A user shall be able to override planned pa rameter values,
source_references.excerpt: For a given month and year, in the past two y ears, DigitalHome shall be able to provide a report on the management and control of the home.

requirements.title: Display Refresh Rate and Data Acquisition Rate
requirements.description: Update displays of environmental conditions at least every two seconds and acquire sensor data at a minimum acquisition rate of 10 Hz.

source_references.section: 4.6.2.2 A user shall be able to override planned pa rameter values,
source_references.excerpt: Displays of environmental conditions (tempera ture, humidity, contact sensors and power switches) shall be updated at least every two seconds.

requirements.title: Daily Automated System Backup and Recovery
requirements.description: Perform daily automated backups of all system configuration, default settings, planning, and usage data, and automatically restore data upon failure recovery.

source_references.section: 4.6.2.2 A user shall be able to override planned pa rameter values,
source_references.excerpt: The DH System will backup all system data ( configuration, default parameter settings, planning, and usage data) on a daily basis

requirements.title: User Authentication and Encryption
requirements.description: Require an account name and password for login, while securing communication using TLS encryption and standard authentication methods.

source_references.section: 5.2.3 All DigitalHome operations shall incorporate exception handling so that
source_references.excerpt: Log in to an account shall require entry of a n account name and a password.

requirements.title: Project Documentation Archiving
requirements.description: Maintain up-to-date system documentation following HomeOwner document formats and store all required project artifacts in the HomeOwner Document Archive upon completion.

source_references.section: 5.2.3 All DigitalHome operations shall incorporate exception handling so that

test_cases.title: Monitor and Update Thermostat Target Temperature within Valid Range
preconditions: The user is authenticated and the thermostat device is online.

steps.action: Navigate to the Thermostat Control page on the DigitalHome web interface.
steps.expected_result: The current temperature reading from the thermostat is displayed.

steps.action: Enter a target temperature of 72°F in the target temperature field and click Save.
steps.expected_result: The target temperature updates to 72°F and a success notification is shown.

steps.action: Refresh the Thermostat Control page.
steps.expected_result: The target temperature remains persistent at 72°F.

source_references.section: 4.2.1.1 A DH user shall be able to read the tempera ture at a thermostat
source_references.excerpt: A DH user shall be able to set the thermost at temperatures to between 60 ° F and 80 ° F, inclusive, at one degree increments.

test_cases.title: Verify Thermostat Temperature Lower and Upper Boundary Settings
preconditions: Thermostat control page is active on the user interface.

steps.action: Set the thermostat target temperature to 60°F and submit.
steps.expected_result: The system accepts 60°F as the set point without error.

steps.action: Set the thermostat target temperature to 80°F and submit.
steps.expected_result: The system accepts 80°F as the set point without error.

steps.action: Verify current settings on the UI.
steps.expected_result: The target temperature displays 80°F.

source_references.section: 4.2.1.1 A DH user shall be able to read the tempera ture at a thermostat
source_references.excerpt: A DH user shall be able to set the thermost at temperatures to between 60 ° F and 80 ° F, inclusive, at one degree increments.

test_cases.title: Attempt Thermostat Settings Outside Permissible Bounds
preconditions: User is navigating the thermostat temperature adjustment module.

steps.action: Enter 59°F into the thermostat target input box and submit.
steps.expected_result: The input is rejected and an out-of-range error message is displayed.

steps.action: Enter 81°F into the thermostat target input box and submit.
steps.expected_result: The input is rejected and an out-of-range error message is displayed.

steps.action: Verify target temperature setting on the web interface.
steps.expected_result: The target temperature remains unchanged at its previous valid value.

source_references.section: 4.2.1.1 A DH user shall be able to read the tempera ture at a thermostat
source_references.excerpt: A DH user shall be able to set the thermost at temperatures to between 60 ° F and 80 ° F, inclusive, at one degree increments.

test_cases.title: Set Humidistat Humidity Level Within Valid Bounds
preconditions: Humidistat module is connected and functional.

steps.action: Open the Humidistat Control section on the DigitalHome web page.
steps.expected_result: The current relative humidity reading is displayed.

steps.action: Set the relative humidity target to 45% and click Submit.
steps.expected_result: The system accepts 45% and updates the set point display.

steps.action: Refresh the Humidistat Control page.
steps.expected_result: The relative humidity setting displays 45%.

source_references.section: 4.2.1.1 A DH user shall be able to read the tempera ture at a thermostat
source_references.excerpt: A DH user shall be able to set the humidity level for a humidistat, from 30% to 60%, inclusive a 1% increments.

test_cases.title: Verify Humidistat Target Boundaries at 30% and 60%
preconditions: Humidistat interface is loaded.

steps.action: Set the humidistat target humidity level to 30% and save.
steps.expected_result: The system accepts 30% target humidity without error.

steps.action: Set the humidistat target humidity level to 60% and save.
steps.expected_result: The system accepts 60% target humidity without error.

steps.action: Verify target humidity setting on the interface.
steps.expected_result: The target humidity displays 60%.

source_references.section: 4.2.1.1 A DH user shall be able to read the tempera ture at a thermostat
source_references.excerpt: A DH user shall be able to set the humidity level for a humidistat, from 30% to 60%, inclusive a 1% increments.

test_cases.title: Attempt Invalid Humidistat Level Inputs Below 30% or Above 60%
preconditions: Humidistat control module is active.

steps.action: Input 29% for target humidity and submit.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the input and displays a descriptive validation message.

steps.action: Input 61% for target humidity and submit.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the input and displays a descriptive validation message.

steps.action: Check active humidistat setting on the UI.
steps.expected_result: The target humidity value retains its previous valid setting.

test_cases.title: Verify Alarm System Activation on Contact Sensor Breach
preconditions: Security system is armed and contact sensors are monitored.

steps.action: Arm the DigitalHome security system from the security control panel.
steps.expected_result: The system status displays ARMED.

steps.action: Trigger a contact sensor on a monitored door/window to change state to OPEN.
steps.expected_result: The contact sensor status changes to OPEN.

steps.action: Observe the security alarm indicators.
steps.expected_result: Both sound alarm and light alarm sub-systems activate immediately.

test_cases.title: Query State and Toggle Appliance Power Switch
preconditions: Small appliance power switch is connected to the DigitalHome network.

steps.action: Navigate to the Appliance Management module on the web interface.
steps.expected_result: The current power switch state (OFF or ON) for connected appliances is displayed.

steps.action: Click the toggle switch for a selected small appliance power switch currently OFF.
steps.expected_result: The switch changes state to ON, and connected appliance turns on.

steps.action: Click the toggle switch for the same appliance again.
steps.expected_result: The switch changes state to OFF, and connected appliance turns off.
